title: [Master]-Vendor Order No. exceeds 20-character limit causing error in Intercompany Purchase Invoice
summary: Fixes an error in Intercompany Purchase Invoice when the Vendor Order No. is longer than 20 characters. The fix changes the Purchase Invoice page in several localization layers, and the intercompany tests are updated.
key_points: Addresses an error raised when Vendor Order No. exceeds 20 characters in an intercompany purchase invoice
Changes page 51 Purchase Invoice in the APAC, BE, CH, ES, FI, IT, NA, NL, NO, RU and W1 layers
Updates the ERM Intercompany III tests in the W1, CH, CZ and NL layers
quote: Vendor Order No. exceeds 20-character limit causing error in Intercompany Purchase Invoice
